hooks.command: input=$(cat); mkdir -p .constellation/agents; id=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_use_id // empty'); [ -n "$id" ] && printf '%s' "$input" | jq -c --arg ts "$(date +%s)" '{id: .tool_use_id, subagent_type: (.tool_input.subagent_type // "unknown"), description: (.tool_input.description // ""), startedAt: ($ts | tonumber)}' > ".constellation/agents/${id}.json"
